sources.summary: Boris Cherny 介绍犹他州向 10 个州政府部门的 34 名开发者提供了 Claude Code。试点显示 80% 的开发者在 30 分钟内搭好可用环境，71% 的开发者在为期四周的试点结束前报告节省了 20 小时以上时间。该推文引用了 Anthropic 与 GSA 合作将 Claude 以 40% 折扣提供给联邦及各级政府的公告作为背景。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Utah 在 10 个州政府机构的 34 名开发者中试点 Claude Code，为期四周，80% 的人 30 分钟内就搭建好工作环境，71% 反馈节省了 20 多个小时。

en.summary: Boris Cherny says Utah provided Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state government departments. The pilot showed 80% of developers had a working environment set up within 30 minutes, and 71% reported saving more than 20 hours before the four-week pilot ended. The tweet cites as background Anthropic's announcement with GSA that Claude would be offered to federal and all levels of government at a 40% discount.
en.reason: Utah’s four-week Claude Code pilot with 34 developers across 10 state agencies found 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes and 71% reported saving more than 20 hours.
